authenticity.evidence: Some signs of real retail flow: about 2,225 unique buyers in an hour, 2,177 holders, no paid DexScreener promotion, no smart-money or KOL wallets, a low bot/degen rate (0.35%), and a creator who holds nothing. Signs of manipulation: GMGN tags 173 bundler wallets. There are about 13.9k buys but only about 2.2k unique buyers, so roughly 6 buys per buyer. Sells came from only 219 unique wallets, which suggests a small group rotating large volume. Hourly volume was about 85 times liquidity, which is consistent with wash or bot-driven trading. At least 10 copies with the same name and ticker launched within about 20 minutes, which points to a coordinated launch pattern or a sniping farm around a trending Chinese meme.
authenticity.uncertainty: Without X, Douyin or Telegram data I can't tell whether the source meme is actually trending in Chinese social media. The rotation pattern could also be normal high-frequency degen trading on a hot Chinese-language ticker.

structured_output.counterargument: Chinese-language meme tickers on Solana sometimes attract fast, sustained buying from Chinese-speaking traders once one copy becomes the accepted version. This pair has the most real liquidity (about $47k) and volume among the copies, and it has a Douyin note plus an X post linked. It could become the version everyone trades and move well above its $384k ATH if the Douyin meme spreads further. Holder count (2,177) and unique buyers are large for a 35-minute-old token, and there is no paid promotion or dev supply overhang.

structural_risks: About $47k liquidity against $4.1M hourly volume, so turnover is roughly 85x and price can move sharply both ways
GeckoTerminal puts top-10 holders at 95%, probably including the pool, while GMGN says 8.8%, so concentration is unclear
RugCheck flags a large amount of unlocked LP on one market (0% locked) and few LP providers; GMGN reports an LP burn ratio of 1.0, which conflicts with this
173 bundler wallets and only 219 unique sellers suggest a small group rotating supply
Already about 34% below ATH, falling 16–22% in the last 5 minutes
More than 10 same-name copies split the liquidity

narrative.description: A Chinese-language frog meme: the name 错版审美吉蛙 means roughly 'misprint-aesthetic lucky frog', and the ticker 甲亢蛙 means 'hyperthyroid frog'. It is apparently sourced from a Douyin note, and the X link points to a BSC-oriented account (BSCSBTI). This fits the recent pattern of Chinese meme tokens launching on BSC and Solana at the same time.
narrative.why_spreading: A quirky Chinese-language meme from Douyin, likely copied across chains, was picked up quickly by Chinese-speaking degens and sniping bots. The spread shows up mainly as a launch race among copycat tokens, not as evidence of an ongoing story.

source_coverage.notes: No-internet condition; judgment is based only on the evidence packet.

structured_output.thesis: A 35-minute-old Solana copy of a Chinese Douyin frog meme. It is one of more than 10 tokens with the same name, it was not the first launched, and at least one rival (ENCK) has similar liquidity. Volume is extreme relative to liquidity (about 85x in one hour) and is heavily bundled: 173 bundler wallets, about 6 buys per unique buyer, and only 219 unique sellers. Price is already about 34% below ATH and dropping fast. Unless this copy clearly becomes the accepted version and the source meme spreads well beyond Douyin, the usual outcome is a fast fade as bundlers and snipers exit into thin liquidity.

token_connection.why_this_token: This copy has the most real liquidity (about $47k) and the highest volume among the same-name tokens, and it links a Douyin note and an X post. It has no exclusive claim to the meme, though.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 10 tokens share the name 错版审美吉蛙 and ticker 甲亢蛙, launched within about 20 minutes of each other. Several launched earlier: 766xDh6… at 1790143081, 6LUk3… at 1790143170 and ENCK19… at 1790143221. ENCK19… has $40.6k liquidity and $1.24M hourly volume. 6LUk3… traded $736k and HcpCm… $584k in the hour. The meme may also have originated on BSC, judging by the BSCSBTI account.

unknowns: Whether the Douyin meme is actually trending among Chinese audiences
Whether a BSC version is the real main market
Who controls the unlocked LP portion and whether it can be pulled
How much of the top-10 concentration is the pool rather than wallets
Whether Chinese call groups or KOLs are backing this particular copy
structured_output.what_is_happening: A Chinese-language frog meme token launched on the Meteora virtual curve, migrated instantly to PumpSwap, and went up about 400–460% in its first 35 minutes on $4.1M of volume against about $48k liquidity. It is one of more than 10 copies with the same name launched within minutes of each other. It is now pulling back hard: down 16–22% in 5 minutes and about 34% below its $384k ATH.
